title: rbac v2: enforce audit log KMS region pinning + policy upgrades
author: Liam O'Connor
description: Summary: Enforce RBAC v2 policy checks for audit logging paths and add KMS region pinning validation for customer-managed keys. This PR upgrades RBAC v2 policies to include explicit audit-log roles, wires the policy checks through the audit log writer, and adds a KMS region pinning validator that prevents keys from being used outside allowed regions (data residency). Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require stronger guarantees that audit logs and encrypted artifacts never leave approved regions and that RBAC controls cover audit ingestion and administrative actions. This change closes gaps found during a compliance review (see Linear ENG-5231) and hardens the KMS integration against misconfiguration.

ci_summary: All pipeline stages passed after re-run. Initial lint failure fixed (unused import) and one flaky e2e re-run succeeded. Coverage: +0.6% on pkg/kms. Security scan: no new findings.
release_notes: Enforces RBAC v2 checks for audit logging flows; adds customer KMS region pinning validation to prevent cross-region usage of pinned keys; backfill migration to add audit roles for existing orgs. This is a security/compliance improvement and should be rolled out with the org-admin migration flag toggled on.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for RBAC mappings and KMS validator. Integration test simulates cross-region key usage and expected rejection. Migration includes batching; run on staging and monitor backfill progress metric 'migration.audit_roles.backfilled' before enabling on prod.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy to staging with feature flag 'rbac_v2_audit_enforce' off. 2) Run migration in read-only window (batch size 500 orgs). 3) Enable enforcement for a small org subset (canary). 4) Monitor audit ingestion error rate and migration metrics for 48h. 5) Gradual ramp to all orgs and disable feature flag. 6) Notify customers with pinned keys about region constraint via console banner.
security_impact: High: changes the enforcement surface for audit logs and key usage. Requires coordination with SRE and customer success for tenant migrations and key management. No secret material introduced in this PR.
